changes_made.explanation: Added Masked Language Modeling as a second NLG task. Normalized dataset names by removing spaces before 'WMT14' and standardized capitalization. Consolidated model variants under simple names. Simplified output descriptions while keeping all relevant types.
Normalized metric capitalization (BLEU instead of bleu, Perplexity instead of perplexity). MACs is correctly capitalized. All metrics are used to evaluate NLG outputs.
No LLM-based evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper focuses on architectural improvements to Transformers, not on using LLMs as judges.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. Evaluation is conducted entirely through automatic metrics (BLEU, Perplexity) and computational efficiency measures (MACs).

overall_notes: This paper proposes a novel Mixture of Attention Heads (MoA) architecture for Transformer models. It evaluates on two NLG tasks (Machine Translation and Masked Language Modeling) using standard automatic metrics. The extraction was generally accurate, but needed normalization of capitalization and consolidation of model/dataset variations. The paper does not involve human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methodologies.
